summary.text: NEWSPACE NORTH AS is a private limited company registered in Andenes, founded 2021-12-06. Its website describes the business as follows: "NewSpace North fosters innovation in the space sector by driving collaboration between startups, industry leaders, and research institutions." Its main industry code is 72.100: research and experimental development on natural sciences and engineering. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 4 700 213 NOK and the annual result was 1 560 615 NOK; operating income was up from 1 700 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 71 651 NOK in 2024 to 1 560 615 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 277 361 NOK in 2024 to 1 143 843 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is newspacenorth.com, which links to its Facebook, LinkedIn profiles. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-12 (harRegistrertAntallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
